description.p: Inkwell keeps your notes as plain Markdown files in a folder on your computer, and links them together so ideas are easy to find again. Nothing is locked into a database: your notes stay readable in any text editor.

ul.li: Live preview: formatting appears as you type
Links between notes, backlinks, tags and a graph of how everything connects
Tick boxes, callouts, tables, properties, and HTML that shows like a web page
Bookmarks, daily notes, templates and file recovery
Light and dark themes with your own colours and text size
An optional password, so you can reach your notes from your phone
